from-the-bridge.title: From The Bridge to Hugo
from-the-bridge.content_html:
This article begins on The Bridge and is retrieved during a trusted Hugo build.
Hugo publishes bounded, sanitized static HTML while the source topic, replies,
moderation and identity remain here.

Static does not mean disconnected

DiscussionBridge keeps the generated page free of receiver credentials and live
application state. A later build can refresh the forum-owned article and its
discussion without transferring ownership to Hugo.

One source of truth

The Bridge remains authoritative for this article and conversation. Hugo owns
the generated presentation. Readers can reply through the embedded discussion
or open this topic directly.

A portable publishing profile

The same contract supports Hugo locally, in CI, or on a static deployment host.
Only the trusted build process receives the connection credential.
